creator: Alexander Terp
description: Raised by the Antigravity lead (kayak), 2026-11-21. The reviewed design ~/src/antigravity-project/design-muster.md, section 'Offer mid-turn delivery after approval and a proof probe' and build step 6, specifies an optional route: an attributed PreInvocation hook obtains a bounded batch of unread messages, injects them with injectSteps, and the daemon advances places only on a verified receipt. Not built in the Antigravity round: agy panes get messages by the typed wake at idle, like any harness with a readable prompt. Trigger: build this when a busy agy pane not receiving urgent posts actually costs something, or when Foreman needs a brief receipt stronger than a place advance. First step is the proof probe the design lists (how to confirm an injection was applied; counter reuse across turns and compaction; a timed-out or malformed hook). The lead's ruling, delegated by the owner: this is an agy-only exception to message-delivery-path, to be enabled only after that probe; marked for owner review.
title: Antigravity: deliver messages mid-turn through PreInvocation, with a receipt
